pr.title: feat(rules): pattern and regex mute filters
pr.body:
feat(rules): pattern and regex mute filters

<!-- git-stk:description -->
Pattern and regex mute filters, for noisier suppression than exact-login mutes.

`[[rules.mute]]` entries match on `author`, `title`, or `excerpt`. Default is a case-insensitive substring match; `regex = true` switches to a full regex (use `(?i)` for case-insensitivity). Patterns compile once at startup, so a bad regex is a config error, not a per-event surprise.

Closes #44.
<!-- /git-stk:description -->

<!-- git-stk:closes -->
Closes #44
<!-- /git-stk:closes -->
